newsitem.title: JAPAN: Canon shares fall ahead of end-March book closing.
newsitem.headline: Canon shares fall ahead of end-March book closing.

text.p: Canon Inc shares were lower in Monday afternoon trade, battered by profit-taking as well as selling ahead of the end-March book closing, brokers said.
As of 0457 GMT, the shares were down 110 yen at 2,530 yen, the 10th largest percentage loser on the first section of the bourse.

"There are quite a few blue-chip stocks such as Canon which need to be sold," a trader at a foreign brokerage said. "The cash stocks can't be sold off at once so sellers are getting rid of them gradually through arbitrage selling."
